items.q: I went there and then for a while he would go and he would see me going on little trips and sometimes he turn the band over to me,

ctx.x: Yes. They had a pythian band, and of course he taught in high school at Sand Springs, that's a little suburb town.
I went there and then for a while he would go and he would see me going on little trips and sometimes he turn the band over to me,
the marching band, over to me. I liked that.
